events.text: The ripple says T-455 is in review on a side branch. I'll check whether the other blockers are actually done before changing how T-466 builds its review links.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show T-466 and blocker statuses
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py show T-466 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "---- BLOCKERS ----"; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-455 branch vs main
events.input: $ git branch -a --list '*t455*' '*revops*' 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "----"; git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; echo "---- log T-466 decision head ----"; git log -1 --oneline; echo "---- branch vs main ----"; git rev-parse agent/t455-knowledge 2>/dev/null; git rev-parse main 2>/dev/null; git rev-list --left-right --count main...agent/t455-knowledge 2>/dev/null || echo "compare failed"
